description: By IAM simulation of every role outside AWS's service-linked path, only the operator's elevated role can create a role, attach or put a policy, or rewrite a trust on an arbitrary role. The elevation workflow and its backstop hold such rights only on Identity Center's reserved path, which the simulated target is outside

matrix_rows.gap: AWS identity policies only: GCP's Policy Analyzer needs an organization, and the project owner holds IAM change in GCP standing. Organization policy mutation does not apply -- there is no AWS organization policy in use.
